name: Perils of Salvaging (The Combat Zone (Pacifica), 2070)
description: Neon At Home's 2070 version of Salvaging Night City's tables, for the Night City of the Edgerunner's Handbook. Import this table to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy. Edit a result's wording and Neon At Home shows yours; the peril's dice stay the module's.

results.text: A floor of a half-built hotel gives way under you. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), and a Critical Injury to the Body.
A Voodoo Boys or BARGHEST patrol calls it trespassing. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
A scav cell decides your chrome is worth more than their haul. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).

Down a dead elevator shaft in the Grand Imperial Mall. A 30m fall when the ground gives: 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), unless a Grapple Hand or Gun, or a DV15 Athletics Check to grab the edge, saves you.

Rot gas built up in a sealed parking garage. A pocket of toxic gas for a round, as a Vial of Biotoxin: beat DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs or take 3d6 straight to HP. An Anti-Smog Breathing Mask or an air supply keeps it off.
A Voodoo Boys power tap, live. A live wire: electrocuted for a round, 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
